MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 17

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 9

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

5. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400

   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

10. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 3

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 24

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. B — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²

Final Answer: 13 cm
